subject: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cohen <alex.cohen@gmail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen

Hi Alex,

Great talking yesterday — excited about the potential of you joining the serving runtime team. Attached is a provisional offer letter for the Staff ML Engineer role (Redwood_Provisional_Offer_AlexCohen_v1.pdf). This is the version keyed to the comp band we discussed (Band 5 — staff). Please review; a few notes up front: 

- Base salary, sign-on, and equity are called out in Section 1–3.
- We include a 90-day probation clause (standard for employees joining from outside US-based contractors) that ties a portion of the sign-on payment to successful completion of 90 days. We can discuss alternative phasing.
- Start date is tentatively 2026-11-02 — flexible by up to two weeks on your side.
- Role reports to Vivek. We're aiming to route the final to DocuSign once HR and hiring manager sign off.

Next steps: please send any redlines or questions by EOD Monday (9/14) so we can route approvals and finalize. If you prefer a short call to walk through the letter, I can book 20 minutes.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachment: Redwood_Provisional_Offer_AlexCohen_v1.pdf

From: Alex Cohen <alex.cohen@gmail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T07:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen

Hi Grace — thanks for sending this so quickly. A few items/questions after a first pass: 

1) Probation clause: I'm okay with a standard review but would like the sign-on to be paid in two installments (50% on start, 50% after 90 days), rather than being withheld in full.
2) Start date: would prefer 11/16 if that's workable — I have a pre-planned commitment the week of 11/2.
3) Equity vesting: can we confirm whether the grant cliff is 6 months or 1 year? The wording in Section 3 seems ambiguous.
4) Can you confirm visa sponsorship is not required (I am a US citizen).

I've attached a brief counterproposal doc that shows the two-installment sign-on and a 6-month cliff request for clarity.

Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: Alex_Cohen_Counterproposal.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen

Vivek / Marissa — forwarding Alex's counterproposal and questions (below). Can you confirm whether we can: 

- Accept splitting the sign-on into two installments (50/50) tied to start + 90 days.
- Move start to 2026-11-16 (candidate preference).
- Apply a 6-month cliff for the equity grant? Our standard is 1 year but we've done 6 months for senior ICs in the past with leadership sign-off.

Alex is an excellent fit — hiring manager eager to keep momentum. If both of you can reply with approvals or suggested language by EOD 9/15, I'll prepare a redlined offer and route for final signature.

FW: 
> From: Alex Cohen <alex.cohen@gmail.com>
> Date: 2026-09-13T07:44:00-07:00
> Subject: Re: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen
> 
> (candidate message with counterproposal attached)

Thanks,
Grace

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen

Thanks for the ping. I'm supportive of the candidate's requests with the following conditions: 

- Sign-on in two installments (50% at start, 50% after 90 days) — approved.
- Start date 2026-11-16 — approved. Hiring timeline won't be impacted.
- Equity cliff: I'm comfortable with a 6-month cliff for this hire given the seniority and the strategic nature of the role, but I'd like HR/legal to sign off on the deviation from standard.

One more ask: can we add an explicit statement that the role is eligible for Redwood Optimize bonus eligibility after the first review period? Please add a single-sentence note in the compensation section.

Link: https://hub.redwood.com/hiring/pipeline/ALEX-2026

-Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional Offer and Pre-Start Conditions — Alex Cohen

Thanks — I've reviewed Alex's counterproposal and Vivek's notes. HR/legal redlines attached (Offer_Letter_Redline_v1.docx). Summary of changes we will accept: 

- Sign-on payment: split 50% on start date, 50% payable after successful completion of 90 days (subject to standard good-standing clause).
- Start date changed to 2026-11-16 as requested.
- Equity cliff: we will approve a six-month cliff (deviation documented) — include manager sign-off and update the offer to state that the remainder of the equity schedule follows the standard plan.
- Add short sentence on eligibility for Redwood Optimize bonus after the first performance review (non-guaranteed).

Legal asks that we keep the probation language but soften the hurdle language: replace "forfeiture" wording with "withholding pending successful completion of 90 days in good standing." Attached contains exact phrasing. Once Grace confirms, I'll prep final for DocuSign and legal countersign.

Attachments: Offer_Letter_Redline_v1.docx

-Marissa Cole
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cohen <alex.cohen@gmail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Offer Letter (updated) — Alex Cohen

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed your counterproposal with the hiring team and HR/legal. Please see the attached redlined offer; the key updates we are able to commit to: 

• Sign-on will be paid 50% on start date (11/16/2026) and 50% after successful completion of 90 days in good standing.
• Start date updated to 2026-11-16.
• Equity grant will have a six-month cliff (documented deviation).
• We've softened the probation language to "withholding pending successful completion of 90 days in good standing."
• Added a sentence confirming eligibility for Redwood Optimize bonus after first review (not guaranteed).

Next steps: please review the attached Offer_Letter_Redline_v1.docx. If everything looks good I'll route this to DocuSign (link will be sent) and target signature by 9/20 so we can lock the headcount and start the onboarding checklist.

If you'd like a quick call to walk the changes, I'll be free tomorrow between 9–11am PT.

Warmly,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Attachments: Offer_Letter_Redline_v1.docx
Related DocuSign (to follow): https://docusign.com/redsandbox/ALEX-2026-offer
